title: Training Institute Franchise Opportunity
name: Lawrence Keogh, 22 Franchisees, Est'd in 2016, London HQ
description: The brand is an international bakery school offering a comprehensive one-year professional bakery program for both beginners and experienced professionals. The curriculum covers a wide range of baking skills and culminates in formal certification, providing students with structured training for starting or advancing careers in baking as well as for enthusiasts seeking professional-level skills. The brand currently operates 22 locations across London, the Middle East, and New York, demonstrating an established international footprint and a proven training model. Its business model is based on delivering structured, long-term professional bakery education through dedicated schools in key markets. The brand's competitive differentiation comes from its comprehensive curriculum, certification-driven value, established international presence, and standardized training concept. Franchise partners can benefit from an established brand, proven curriculum, and franchisor support for setting up and operating bakery schools in new territories such as Japan. Operates with a valid business license.
